title: How to Survive in Gamedev for Eleven Years Without a Hit
summary: Jake Birkett of Grey Alien Games explains at GDC 2016 how an indie developer survived eleven years without a hit by building a long tail of games and redefining success.
why: Recommended in indie and solo game development threads as a grounded account of making a living in games.

quote.text: you can redefine your idea of "success" a little and make a comfortable living
